summary: Iteration 3 (security/auth boundary) tested. Backend: 31/32 pytest tests pass; every PHI endpoint returns 401 unauth, RBAC enforced (admin sees all, editors isolated, viewer read-only), file downloads reject cross-owner access and outside-app-prefix paths, upload paths are user_id-namespaced, session exchange rejects bogus session_id. Frontend: /login renders with google-signin-btn testID and unauth navigation to /dashboard correctly redirects to /login. One MINOR path-traversal finding: literal '..' segments are normalized by the HTTP layer before hitting the handler, so the in-code `".." in path` guard is effectively dead code (encoded-slash traversal is still blocked). No active exploit path for editor/viewer but admins can technically read any orthovault-prefixed object beyond uploads/patients/. No React Native deprecated packages or SafeAreaView issues detected in tested files.

minor.issue: The `'..' in path` guard in server.py:406 is unreachable because Starlette/ingress normalize '../' segments in the URL path before the handler runs. Raw '..' traversal returns 404 (storage miss) instead of the intended 400. Non-admins are still safely blocked by the user_id ownership prefix, but an admin token can read any 'orthovault/...' object outside `uploads/patients/`. Recommend enforcing the ownership prefix for admins too or moving the check to a middleware that inspects the raw request path.

action_items: (Minor) Harden file-download path check: `'..' in path` is dead code after URL normalization. Either (a) add per-role prefix enforcement for admin as well, or (b) validate the raw ASGI scope path/segment list. Current risk is limited to admin-token cross-namespace reads within the orthovault app bucket.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:162 `current_user` accepts token via query param `?token=` in addition to Authorization header — acceptable for signed download links but should be documented; ensure it's not logged in access logs.
server.py:299 uses find({}, ...).to_list(2000). Fine for now; consider pagination when patient counts grow.
server.py:519 email unique index will fail startup if pre-existing duplicate emails exist; not an issue for a fresh deployment.

rca_of_issue: Path traversal test failure RCA: URL '/api/files/orthovault/uploads/patients/../../etc/passwd' is normalized by Starlette's routing layer to '/api/files/orthovault/etc/passwd' before the handler executes, so `'..' in path` is never true. Storage returns 404 because the object doesn't exist — SAFE by accident, not by design. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer test_token_admin' '<base>/api/files/orthovault/uploads/patients/../../etc/passwd'` returns 404 (expected 400). The encoded-slash variant `%2f..%2f` bypasses normalization and correctly returns 400, confirming the ingress normalization theory. Mitigation: enforce role-based prefix for admins too, or inspect raw scope['raw_path'].
